description: This file defines a mock class 'ControlServerInternalMock' for the 'IControlServerInternal' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for setting application state, acknowledging messages, pinging, and registering clients.

classes.name: ControlServerInternalMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IControlServerInternal interface for testing purposes.
